name: parallel
description: Connect Parallel to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Parallel MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Parallel to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with web search and extraction using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Parallel workspace.
Find anything in Parallel that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review web search and extraction in Parallel.
